# RC.dev — Ricardo Fernandes

> Software engineer. Portfolio, work history and a technical blog, in
> Portuguese (default) and English (under /en).

Stack: TypeScript, Next.js (App Router), NestJS, Prisma, PostgreSQL.

## Pages
- /en — home: featured projects and recent posts
- /en/projects — every project, with stack and source links
- /en/experiences — work history, newest first
- /en/about — bio, skills, languages, education
- /en/blog — technical notes and architecture decisions
- /en/download — resume as PDF, generated from live data

The Portuguese version of every page lives at the same path without the
/en prefix. Structured data (schema.org Person and BlogPosting) is embedded
in each page.
